messages:
Nadia (Product): Quick sync: micro-review of the Private setup wizard9 connectivity step. Noticed a few layout and a11y friction points on narrow viewports. Demo: https://redwood.design/s/mini-conn
Theo (Design): Main thing: the sticky action bar at the bottom overlaps the per-host mini-controls on mobile. Either shrink the bar or make it dismissible on scroll. Also the new mini-progress meter is subtle; increase track contrast.
Wei (Engineering): For the sticky bar we can auto-hide on scroll-down and show on scroll-up. For the meter I'll bump the stroke to 2px and use a semi-opaque background so contrast improves.
Ana (Accessibility): If auto-hide is used, ensure the bar is still reachable via keyboard (skip link?) and that showing/hiding is announced (aria-hidden toggled). For the meter, provide a text alternative: "4 of 7 probes passed" inside a visually-hidden node that updates with aria-live=polite.
Rory (PM): Copy note: the summary line says 'Network health: degraded' which is too vague. Suggest 'Some checks failed 1 of 7 failed. Actions: Retry or open debug logs.' Make CTA verbs first: 'Continue setup', 'Retry failed checks', 'Open logs'.
Theo (Design): Also microcopy for the per-probe state: replace 'timeout' with 'Connection timed out  check security groups or host firewall'. And change 'skipped' to 'Not required for your config' with a tooltip explaining why.
Wei (Engineering): Implementation plan: collapse inline logs into a stacked slide-down with a max-height and show last 5 lines by default. Add a small chevron to expand and keyboard support for Enter/Space. Debounce probe-state UI updates at 300ms to avoid rapid announcements.
Ana (Accessibility): Keyboard: make host rows into buttons with aria-expanded; when expanded, set focus to the panel heading. Use role=region and aria-labelledby. For toasts about probe completion, keep them in role/status with aria-live=polite and avoid focus theft.
Nadia (Product): Acceptance checklist I'll add: 1) sticky action bar accessible and non-obstructive on mobile, 2) meter and chip colors meet 4.5:1 contrast, 3) aria-live summary visible to screen readers, 4) concise action-first CTAs, 5) expanded logs keyboardable. Tagging @Theo to upload Figma variants and @Wei for a small client patch.
ui-bot: Reminder: design walkthrough at 10:30 in #product-design  bring mobile prototype :bell:
Theo (Design): I'll post two Figma options (auto-hide bar vs compact bar) and updated copy. Expect links in ~90m.
Wei (Engineering): I'll allocate a tiny internal PR to add the aria-live node and debounce. Also will add one e2e to assert the hidden text reads "All probes complete" when finished.
Nadia (Product): Thanks everyone. If you spot any other terse error text that could confuse new users, drop suggestions here and we'll update the copy guide.
